title: Match of the Day
synopsis_short: Highlights of the opening weekend of the 2026/27 Premier League season.
synopsis_medium: Highlights of the opening weekend of the 2026/27 Premier League season, with all three newly promoted teams in action.
synopsis_long: Highlights of the opening weekend of the 2026/27 Premier League season, with all three newly promoted teams in action. Hull kick off at home against Manchester United, Ipswich host Sunderland, and Coventry, back in the top-flight for the first time in 25 years, travel to champions Arsenal on Friday night. Elsewhere, Everton take on Crystal Palace, Nottingham Forest face Leeds, and Brentford meet Spurs.
synopsis_editorial: The season starts with new boys Hull welcoming Man Utd and Coventry at champions Arsenal
